GOOD TO KNOW

A few answers.
A clear next step.

A few useful things to know before you get going.

How do I connect?

Open Home and use the main connection control to start or stop the VPN. The home screen shows the selected country, session time and traffic readouts.

Can I choose another country?

Yes. Open Servers to browse country routes and their displayed latency indicators. Route availability and connection quality can vary.

What does the speed test measure?

The speed screen shows download, upload and ping readings. These describe the tested connection, not a guaranteed speed.

Where are the privacy details?

Read our Privacy policy. For product or privacy questions, email buzzlellc5@gmail.com.
